access.credential_access: create an app in Developer Hub

mcp.details: Intercom provides a remote MCP server that AI applications connect to for securely retrieving workspace data and executing specific functions after verifying user permissions.
mcp.auth: Follows the authenticated remote MCP specification to verify user permissions.

evidence.claim: OAuth is for if you're building a public app that accesses other people's Intercom data.
An Access Token is for if you're using the API to access data in your own Intercom workspace.
You currently ask people for their API Keys to request resources on their behalf.
You are also required to set up OAuth so that your app has permission to access and interact with customers' data.
Intercom provides a documented public REST API for retrieving and updating account information and integrating with custom products.
The API uses HTTP methods (GET, POST, DELETE), returns JSON encoded data, and requires HTTPS.
The Intercom API provides programmatic access to the platform and is defined using the OpenAPI Specification for HTTP APIs.
Development workspaces are free and intended for development purposes only.
sign up here to create your free account.
To interact with the Intercom Platform you need an app. You can create an app for any of your workspaces in the Your apps section of the Developer Hub.
Intercom hosts a remote MCP server that enables AI tools to securely access and interact with workspace data.
The MCP server follows the authenticated remote MCP specification to verify user permissions before granting access.
The Intercom MCP Server provides six tools for interacting with the Intercom API.
